title: Peter Garyaev's retracted Nobel nomination and death

tellings.quote: gentleman Peter Garyaev who was nominated for the Nobel Prize in 2019 or 2020. The nomination was retracted and he later died, I believe, under mysterious circumstances.

plain: A Russian researcher named Peter Garyaev, linked to an idea called linguistic wave genetics, is said to have been nominated for the Nobel Prize, the top award in science, in 2019 or 2020, only for the nomination to be withdrawn, and he later died, in the teller's words, "I believe, under mysterious circumstances." Dave Rossi, a guest who says he was taught advanced physics by non-human beings, tells this as a researcher summarising, crediting a website on linguistic wave genetics rather than any person. He raises it as a sign that this kind of work gets pushed aside.
